datasets.label: Hubble · optical
datasets.title: Ring Nebula in visible light
datasets.description: ESA/Hubble's photograph of the Ring Nebula, in He II 469, H-beta 487, [O III] 502, continuum 645, H-alpha 656, [N II] 658 and [S II] 673 nm. It lies on the walls the nebula's spectra give: a shell seen almost pole-on and a lobe through its opening (O'Dell et al. 2013).
datasets.summary: The photograph on the nebula's walls: a shell and a lobe through it, at depths from published expansion speeds.
